REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT Francisco Gold Condominium II EDSA Cor. Mapagmahal St., Diliman Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE BL'AHENG PINOY TAPAT NA PALAKAD, MR. JEREDIGNO P. ATIENZA General Manager Philippine Retirement Authority 29/F Citibank Tower, 8741 Paseo de Roxas Makati City Dear Mr. Atienza: DILG Legal Opinion No. 27 s. 2012 MAR 13 2012 iHE LOCAL GOVERN*ENT Ct:tüRAL RECORDS SECTION RELEAS O s.'lGNATVRE DATE: z aya3 This pertains to your letter seeking this Department's clarificatory opinion on whether or not the benefits and rights under RA 9994 (Expanded Senior Citizens Act of 2010) may also be accorded to our foreign retiree participants who are sixty (60) years old or above. In reply thereto, please be informed that it is not within the jurisdiction/authority of this Department to determine whether or not the benefits and rights under RA 9994 (Expanded Senior Citizens Act of 2010) may also be accorded to our foreign retiree participants who are sixty (60) years old or above. However, for academic discussion, may we invite your attention to the definition of Senior Citizen or Elderly under Article 5 (5.1) of the Implementing Rules and Regulations of Republic Act No. 9994, also known as "Expanded Senior Citizens Act of 2010", which provides and we quote: "(5. l) Senior Citizen or Elderly — refers to any Filipino Citizen who is a resident of the Philippines, and who is sixty (60) years old or above. It may apply to senior citizens with dual citizenship" status provided they prove their Filipino citizenship and have at least six (6) months residency in the Philippines. Also, a Retiree is also defined under Section I (c), Rule III of the Rules and Regulations Implementing Executive Order No. 1037 otherwise known as "CREÄTING THE PHILIPPINE RETIREMENT PARK SYSTEM PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES (OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE PHILIPPINE RETIREMENT AUTHORITY) ". "RETIREE — Any overseas Filipino or foreign national who is at least fifty (50) years old; Provided, however, that in certain cases

Page 12 specified in Rule III of the Rules and Regulations Implementing Letter of Instruction No. 1470, the age requirement may be reduced to forty (40) years; (As amended by Resolution No. 006, Series of 1988) In this regard, it is our considered view that a foreign retiree is not covered by 9994. Hope we have guided you accordingly. Very truly yours, SUSB OQ Director III IS:9 /11
